author: kalepail
body:
Raven independently rechecked sls-097 on 2026-11-06 and confirmed the original trigger is resolved live.

Live recheck: 2026-11-06: independent GETs at 14:16:52Z and 14:19:31Z of https://stellarlight.xyz/api/openapi.json returned 200, version 1.9.122. POST /api/partners/match now documents 502 application/json ErrorResponse with required string error and GET /api/partners filters fallback, matching merged PR 1929 (56f10c0e03ca93634c26faf3432b607fecbc5cd8). The original JSON and both current handler 502 bodies validate against the live schema; negative controls fail. Independent offline pinned-handler fixtures confirm five 502 fixtures plus adjacent 503/500 behavior. This resolves the original documentation omission. No model-backed POST ran, current ranking availability is unknown, and no gateway-format repair is claimed.

The active finding is being retired under the ephemeral improvements lifecycle. Immutable source snapshot: https://github.com/stellar-experimental/stellar-raven/blob/a73e0b25c4062ca4e3c4382e501630a631ff4656/improvements/stellar-light-scout/sls-097-partner-match-undocumented-502.md
